title: fix: resolve CI test failures in DashboardRenderer and ReportViewer tests
body:
Two test failures on `main` introduced by recent merges.

- **DashboardRenderer.designMode.test**: Overly broad `.pointer-events-none` selector matched data-table ghost rows (internal implementation detail unrelated to design mode). Narrowed selector with `:not([data-testid="ghost-row"])`.

- **ReportViewer.test**: Color assertion expected `rgb(187, 247, 208)` but happy-dom preserves hex values as-is. Updated to assert `#bbf7d0`.

```diff
- expect(container.querySelector('.pointer-events-none')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
+ expect(container.querySelector('.pointer-events-none:not([data-testid="ghost-row"])')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
```

```diff
- expect(wonCell?.style.backgroundColor).toBe('rgb(187, 247, 208)');
+ expect(wonCell?.style.backgroundColor).toBe('#bbf7d0');
```

**Note**: The DashboardRenderer test's `vi.mock('@object-ui/react')` is ineffective because `vitest.setup.tsx` pre-loads `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, binding the real `SchemaRenderer` before the mock takes effect. This causes actual data-table components (with ghost rows) to render in the test. A broader fix to the mock strategy is out of scope here.
